units.title: Core words
units.note: 吗 at the end of a statement turns it into a yes/no question.

units.title: Everyday verbs
units.note: 会 is a learned ability; 能 is a circumstantial possibility.

units.title: Everyday verbs
units.note: 呢 bounces a question back (你呢?) or marks "what about…".

units.title: Everyday verbs
units.note: 有 is "to have" and "there is" — negate it with 没有, never 不有.

units.title: People & family
units.note: 这 "this" and 那 "that" take a measure word before the noun: 这本书.

units.title: Everyday verbs
units.note: 着 after a verb marks an ongoing state: 开着门.

units.title: Everyday verbs
units.note: 应该 "should" goes before the verb: 你应该去.

units.title: Work & school
units.note: 个 is the default measure word — use it when unsure which one a noun takes.

units.title: Colors
units.note: 了 after a verb marks a completed or changed action.

units.title: Places
units.note: 能 asks or grants possibility: 能帮我吗?

units.title: Weather & nature
units.note: 想 is "would like to"; 要 is a firmer "want to / will".

units.title: Everyday verbs
units.note: 还 is "still / also"; 再 is "again", for an action not yet repeated.

units.title: Getting around
units.note: 比 compares: A 比 B + adjective — 我比你高.

units.title: Places
units.note: 就 says something happens sooner or easily; 才 that it takes longer.

units.title: Tech & media
units.note: 让 "to let / make someone do" takes a person, then a verb: 让我看看.

units.title: People & family
units.note: 最 marks the superlative: 最好 "best".

units.title: Band 7 · Unit 15
units.note: 几 asks "how many" for small counts, 多少 for larger or open ones.

units.title: Band 7 · Unit 16
units.note: 请 before a verb makes a polite request: 请坐.

units.title: Band 4 · Unit 13
units.note: 虽然… 但是… keeps both halves of "although… still…".

units.title: Band 5 · Unit 35
units.note: 从… 到… traces "from… to…" in space or time.
